title.narrative: Citizen science approaches and Climate Risk Informed Decision Analysis (CRIDA) methodology for sustainable water management under climate change,

description.narrative: The Workplan aim to strengthen the sustainable water management of the Kaduna River Basin and Lower Benue Basin by Integrating the Climate Risk Informed Decision Analysis (CRIDA) methodology with citizen science to help strengthen capacity for addressing extreme climate risks, monitor water quality, and fill data gaps for sustainable water management. in the Kaduna River Basin and/or Lower Benue Basin Two main activities will be implemented 1) IHP committee, stakeholder and local community engagement on sustainable water management under climate change as well capacity building on CRIDA; and 2) Mini Pilot CRIDA vulnerability assessment using the Kaduna river and/or lower Benue Basin - Application of CRIDA Methodology
